router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED plan-test linux macos linux-arm tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.plan-test:
name: the planner's own test
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 ci/tiers-test.py
ci.yml.linux:
name: linux x86-64 (every gate)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain

      - name: wolf fmt --check
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/check-fmt

      - name: the generated sources are the generated ones
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          python3 tools/gen-hooks --check
          python3 -c "import unicodedata; print('runner Unicode', unicodedata.unidata_version)"
          if python3 -c "import unicodedata, sys; sys.exit(unicodedata.unidata_version != '16.0.0')"; then
            python3 tools/gen-fold --check
          else
            echo "::notice::runner Python is not Unicode 16.0.0; the fold table is checked on kasumi"
          fi

      - name: build, both tiers
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/build --all

      - name: wolf test (the matcher's rows, frecency at frozen times, the codecs)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/check-test

      - name: the same unit tests on the reference interpreter
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          .wolf-bin/lupin run src/matcher_test.lu
          .wolf-bin/lupin run src/db_test.lu

      - name: the 322 probe rows, both tiers
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          tools/probe-check target/native/lope
          tools/probe-check target/release/lope

      - name: the oracle corpus (654 cases, floor tests/oracle/FLOOR), both tiers
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          tools/oracle-check target/native/lope
          tools/oracle-check target/release/lope

      - name: the fold record (floor tests/oracle/FOLD-FLOOR)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/fold-check target/release/lope

      - name: gump's command lines (95 rows)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/cli-check target/release/lope

      - name: import from hand-written fixtures
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/import-check target/release/lope

      - name: edit, and its refusals (no editor at all, as on PAX)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/edit-check target/release/lope

      - name: strace, for the sync census
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq strace >/dev/null
          strace -V | head -1

      # The store's save in its system calls (ruling #96 D9): the temporary
      # file created exclusively, written, synced, renamed over the store,
      # the directory synced; four failures injected. The scratch store is
      # under $RUNNER_TEMP, on the runner's disk (a sync on tmpfs is free),
      # and the cost per save is printed, not gated.
      - name: the store's syncs, seen in its system calls, both tiers
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        env:
          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: |
          tools/sync-census target/native/lope
          tools/sync-census target/release/lope

      - name: the shells for the hook sessions
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq zsh fish fzf >/dev/null
          bash --version | head -1
          zsh --version
          fish --version

      - name: the hooks on PTYs (bash, zsh, fish)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: python3 tools/hook-sessions --tool lope=target/release/lope --shells bash,zsh,fish --expect tests/hooks/expected.tsv --logs hook-logs

      - name: pelt at pelt.pin, for its hook (lope#3)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/fetch-pelt

      - name: the hooks on PTYs (pelt at pelt.pin)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: python3 tools/hook-sessions --tool lope=target/release/lope --shells pelt --pelt .pelt/target/release/pelt --expect tests/hooks/expected.tsv --logs hook-logs-pelt

      - name: gump at gump.pin, for the speed gate
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/fetch-gump

      - name: speed, lope against gump (query no slower; taskset -c 0-3)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/speed target/release/lope .gump/target/release/gump

      - name: the static x86-64 build and its digest (PAX)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/mkstatic target/static

      - name: the harnesses see a difference (the planted reds)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/selftest target/release/lope
ci.yml.macos:
name: macOS arm64
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain

      - name: build, both tiers
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/build --all

      - name: wolf test
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/check-test

      - name: the probe rows, the corpus, the fold record
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          tools/probe-check target/release/lope
          tools/oracle-check target/release/lope
          tools/fold-check target/release/lope

      - name: gump's command lines, import, edit
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          tools/cli-check target/release/lope
          tools/import-check target/release/lope
          tools/edit-check target/release/lope

      # macOS's own bash is 3.2, which has no READLINE_LINE (the bash hook
      # leaves the jump out there, by its version check); zsh is the
      # shell macOS starts.
      - name: the hooks on PTYs (zsh)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: python3 tools/hook-sessions --tool lope=target/release/lope --shells zsh --fzf "" --expect tests/hooks/expected.tsv --logs hook-logs
ci.yml.linux-arm:
name: linux aarch64
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux-arm')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain

      # wolf 0.2.34, like 0.2.24..0.2.33 (pelt's CI), builds NO tier on
      # linux aarch64 (wolf-lang#614): both refusals are asserted by name,
      # so the day a tier arrives this goes red and the matrix widens.
      - name: both tiers are refused on this host, by name (wolf-lang#614)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          tools/build --native >native.log 2>&1
          n=$?
          tools/build --release >release.log 2>&1
          r=$?
          set -e
          cat native.log release.log
          if [ "$n" = 0 ] || [ "$r" = 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::a tier now builds on linux aarch64 (native $n, release $r); widen the matrix"
            exit 1
          fi
          grep -q "this host cannot run the native tier" native.log
          grep -q "this host cannot run the release tier" release.log

      - name: the unit tests on the reference interpreter
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          .wolf-bin/lupin run src/matcher_test.lu
          .wolf-bin/lupin run src/db_test.lu
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
      - macos
      - linux-arm
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: every chosen job succeeded, every other was skipped
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 ci/tiers.py verdict
